players.list.description: List connected player accounts, display names, health and positions.

items.search.description: Find registered item IDs by ID or readable description. Use returned IDs for inventory.give.

query.description: Case-insensitive words in an item ID or description.

items.search.returns: Up to 10 {id, description} matches in stable ID order; more indicates additional matches.

inventory.give.description: Give an existing item to connected players immediately. Check the returned delivered and leftover counts; a full inventory may receive fewer items.

target.description: self, all, an exact connected player account, or an unambiguous profile display name.

item.description: Exact registered item ID, for example mcl_tools:sword_diamond, or an unambiguous readable description. An ambiguous description is refused; items.search discovers IDs.

count.description: Number of items per targeted player.

players.heal.description: Restore targeted players to their configured maximum health.

target.description: self, all, an exact connected player account, or an unambiguous profile display name.

players.teleport.description: Teleport connected players immediately to explicit world coordinates.

inventory.list.description: Inspect up to eight nonempty inventory slots per targeted player. Use this to check what players actually received.
